BAY PROCEDURE Tacoma RV Center · Document Library CONCERN temperature dial OFF but compressor still running, freezer frozen solid MODEL Furrion FCR10 DATE 2026-10-09 WO# - PRIMARY Furrion fridge service manual, thermostat prove, page 31 and page 43. VISUAL FLOWCHART Dial is OFF and the compressor is still running. Compressor stops with C and T open, no jumper? Escalate the inverter and the harness. Replace the Spark-Free Thermostat part G 2021128850. YES NO BAY PROCEDURE Bay order · Tacoma RV Center WHAT THIS PATTERN USUALLY MEANS The temperature dial is fully OFF and the compressor is still running, or the cavity is over-cold. That is a thermostat run-call, not a no-cool ice pattern. Leave the dial fully OFF, seat the probe and the thermostat wires, then open C and T with no jumper. BAY ORDER (DO THIS FIRST) 1. Confirm the temperature dial is fully OFF, past the detent, and the compressor is still running or the cavity is over-cold. Seat the capillary probe and the blue and black thermostat wires, then go to the open-terminal prove. 2. Disconnect flag terminals C (blue) and T (black) and leave them open with no jumper. Leave the dial fully OFF. If the compressor stops, go to the Spark-Free Thermostat replacement. 3. If the compressor stops with C and T open, replace the Spark-Free Thermostat part G 2021128850 (retail C-FCR10DCGTA-007). Straighten the probe, reseat it, and reconnect the wires. That is the confirmed correction when the compressor stops. 4. If the compressor keeps running with C and T open, the run call is downstream of the thermostat. Escalate the inverter and the harness. At the inverter, C and T may be reversed without affecting performance. DO NOT - Do not jumper C and T on this prove. - Do not open the fuse, and do not run a 12V continuity check, while the dial is OFF and the compressor is still running. - Do not replace the cooling unit while the dial is OFF and the compressor is still running. SOURCES (SHOP DOCUMENT LIBRARY) - Furrion FCR08/FCR10 SM CCD-0008122 page 31 Open flag terminals C (blue) and T (black) and leave them open with no jumper. - Furrion FCR08/FCR10 SM CCD-0008122 page 43 Spark-Free Thermostat part G 2021128850 (retail C-FCR10DCGTA-007). - Furrion FCR08/FCR10 SM CCD-0008122 page 45 If the compressor keeps running with C and T open, escalate the inverter and the harness.
